description: This file defines an abstract base class for a Ditto service, handling startup procedures, configuration, actor initialization, and integration with metrics and management tools within an Akka-based distributed system.

classes.name: RootActorInformation
classes.description: Immutable class that bundles the Props and name of a root actor for startup and management purposes.

methods.name: determineRawConfig
methods.description: Template method to determine the raw configuration; can be overridden.

methods.name: appendDittoInfo
methods.description: Adds identifying and environment info to the configuration.

methods.name: tryToGetDittoConfigOrEmpty
methods.description: Attempts to extract the specific ditto configuration, handles type errors.

methods.name: getDittoConfigOrEmpty
methods.description: Fetches the nested config for Ditto, or returns an empty config.

methods.name: getServiceSpecificConfig
methods.description: Abstract method to derive specific configuration from the general config.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Public method to initiate the startup process, returning the ActorSystem.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Performs the full startup routine, including config, metrics, cluster, and actor setup.

methods.name: appendAkkaPersistenceMongoUriToRawConfig
methods.description: Injects MongoDB URI into config if needed.

methods.name: isServiceWithMongoDbConfig
methods.description: Checks if the specific config includes MongoDB settings.

methods.name: logRuntimeParameters
methods.description: Logs Java runtime arguments and CPU info.

methods.name: startKamon
methods.description: Initializes Kamon metrics and optionally Prometheus.

methods.name: startPrometheusReporter
methods.description: Creates and registers a Prometheus reporter for Kamon.

methods.name: createActorSystem
methods.description: Creates the Akka ActorSystem, can be overridden for custom creation.

methods.name: startAkkaManagement
methods.description: Starts Akka Management extension and logs status.

methods.name: startClusterBootstrap
methods.description: Starts Akka Cluster Bootstrap.

methods.name: startStatusSupplierActor
methods.description: Starts the status supplier actor, overridable.

methods.name: startActor
methods.description: Helper to start an actor with name and Props.

methods.name: logStartingActor
methods.description: Logs the start of an actor.

methods.name: startDevOpsCommandsActor
methods.description: Starts the DevOps commands actor.

methods.name: startServiceRootActors
methods.description: Starts root actors after cluster member is up, including main and additional.

methods.name: injectSystemPropertiesLimits
methods.description: Sets system properties to enforce size limits for entities.

methods.name: getDistributedPubSubMediatorActor
methods.description: Retrieves the Akka Distributed Publish-Subscribe mediator.

methods.name: getMainRootActorProps
methods.description: Abstract method to provide Props for main root actor.

methods.name: startMainRootActor
methods.description: Starts the main root actor with given Props.

methods.name: getAdditionalRootActorsInformation
methods.description: Can be overridden to supply additional root actors.

methods.name: startAdditionalRootActors
methods.description: Starts additional root actors from configuration.

methods.name: setUpCoordinatedShutdown
methods.description: Configures clean shutdown procedures for the ActorSystem.
